plain: David Grusch is a former intelligence officer who filed a formal whistleblower complaint about hidden UFO programs. The story is that in 2022 and 2023 he was targeted for it: he was harassed, and his private medical file was leaked. The physicist Eric W. Davis says that both Grusch and his wife were "harassed and intimidated" by someone in the National Reconnaissance Office, the agency that runs US spy satellites. The filmmaker Jeremy Corbell passes on Grusch's own words about the condition named in that file, post-traumatic stress, which Grusch traces to "combat Afghanistan 2013." A Senate staffer named Kurt McConnell gives no details. He says some of what happened to Grusch has never been made public, and that people "went after him" because he went public. If true, it would mean the government punishes people who speak out about this subject.
